people.name: Bethesda
people.line: Pool in Jerusalem where Jesus healed a paralyzed man.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Sheep_Gate
people.line: Gate in Jerusalem near the sheep market

translations.web: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.
translations.bsb: Now there is in Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool with five covered colonnades, which in Hebrew is called Bethesda.
translations.kjv: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
translations.asv: Now there is in Jerusalem by the sheep gate a pool, which is called in Hebrew Bethesda, having five porches.
